basic_profile.bio: I'm a 25-year-old gamer based in Morgantown, West Virginia. By day, I work as a freelance graphic designer, and by night, I dive into the chaotic world of Escape from Tarkov. My interests include gaming, cannabis cultivation, and exploring the nuances of relationship dynamics. I'm currently single and tend to be online during the late evenings and into the night, especially after 10 PM. I dislike overly competitive environments and prefer to engage with communities that value learning and sharing over winning.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong interest in video games, particularly realistic shooters like Escape from Tarkov. My knowledge is largely self-taught through countless hours of gameplay and community discussions. I also have a burgeoning interest in horticulture, especially in the context of cannabis, which I explore through online resources and forums.
